item.title: Wildflower Project Launched to Boost Biodiversity in Lerwick
item.description: New native wildflower sites at Breiwick Road and Rudda Court in Lerwick aim to boost biodiversity and support the endangered Shetland Bumblebee through a Nature Restoration Fund backed pilot project.The post Wildflower Project Launched to Boost Biodiversity in Lerwick appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Western Isles Council Proposes 9.5 Per Cent Council Tax Rise Ahead of Budget Decision
item.description: Comhairle nan Eilean Siar has proposed a 9.5 per cent council tax rise and use of reserves ahead of its 2026 to 2027 budget meeting, citing funding pressures and a projected £15.9 million shortfall.The post Western Isles Council Proposes 9.5 Per Cent Council Tax Rise Ahead of Budget Decision appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Lib Dems Urge Major Boost for Scotland’s Gaming Industry
item.description: Scottish Liberal Democrats have called for a major boost to Scotland’s £188 million gaming industry, proposing regional hubs, a Games Innovation Centre and stronger fair work standards.The post Lib Dems Urge Major Boost for Scotland’s Gaming Industry appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: FOI Reveals £843,743 Spent on Scrapped ‘Brit Card’ Proposal
item.description: An FOI response has revealed £843,743 was spent on the scrapped ‘Brit Card’ proposal before it was abandoned, prompting criticism from the SNP over Westminster spending and policy reversals.The post FOI Reveals £843,743 Spent on Scrapped ‘Brit Card’ Proposal appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Five Taken to Hospital After A82 Crash Near Glencoe
item.description: Five people were taken to hospital after a crash on the A82 south of Glencoe at 10.45am on 21st of February 2026, with police now appealing for witnesses and dash cam footage to help establish what happened.The post Five Taken to Hospital After A82 Crash Near Glencoe appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: MV Isle of Islay Arrives Home After Epic Winter Voyage
item.description: The MV Isle of Islay has arrived in Scotland after a 4400 nautical mile winter voyage from Turkey, boosting capacity on the Islay route and strengthening the resilience of CalMac’s fleet ahead of entering service in March.The post MV Isle of Islay Arrives Home After Epic Winter Voyage appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Findlay Challenges Swinney to Visit Scone Pub Facing Rates Rise
item.description: A Scone publican says a jump in her rates bill from £19,900 to £52,700 could force her to close, as Russell Findlay calls on John Swinney to visit and hear first-hand concerns about revaluations.The post Findlay Challenges Swinney to Visit Scone Pub Facing Rates Rise appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Swinney Says Westminster Chaos Shows Status Quo is Unravelling
item.description: A new poll suggests the SNP is within one seat of a majority at Holyrood, as John Swinney says “constant chaos” at Westminster shows the status quo is unravelling ahead of May’s election.The post Swinney Says Westminster Chaos Shows Status Quo is Unravelling appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Appeal to Trace Missing Hill Walker on Ben Nevis
item.description: Police have renewed their appeal to trace 64 year old hill walker Brian Mcgillicuddy, missing on Ben Nevis since 19th of February 2026, as extensive searches continue in challenging conditions around the CIC Hut and Orion Face Direct.The post Appeal to Trace Missing Hill Walker on Ben Nevis appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: A Character Filled Coastal Home in The Heart of Fortrose
item.description: Set in the heart of Fortrose on the Black Isle, Bishop’s Cottage is a four bedroom detached home with mature gardens and flexible living space, just a short walk from the Moray Firth coastline and village amenities.The post A Character Filled Coastal Home in The Heart of Fortrose appeared first on The Highland Times.
